design_issues.screen: OTP dialog / Tracking dialog / Reject dialog
issues: Radix console warning: 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users' — add DialogTitle (VisuallyHidden if needed) to OTPDialog, tracking-dialog and reject-dialog.

Chromium headless without proprietary codecs reports MEDIA_ERR_SRC_NOT_SUPPORTED (readyState=0, networkState=3, error.code=4) for /chef_showcase.mp4. Not a bug for real users — file is served correctly (video/mp4, 2.6MB, 200) and <video> has autoplay+muted+loop+playsInline. If you want deterministic headless playability, add a WebM source alongside the MP4 in <video>.

action_items: (A11y) Add DialogTitle to all DialogContent instances (OTPDialog, tracking-dialog, reject-dialog) to remove Radix warnings.
(Optional) Provide a WebM fallback source for /chef_showcase.mp4 so it plays in headless Chromium (only affects automated tests; real users unaffected).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 690+ lines with routing for auth, onboarding, menu, orders, revenue, payout, admin, seed and file/upload. Time to split into routers (auth.py, files.py, menu.py, orders.py, revenue.py, admin.py, seed.py) for maintainability.

storage.py: init_storage stores _storage_key in a module global with no lock. Multiple concurrent requests during startup could all POST /init. Fine in practice but consider an asyncio.Lock or eager init at startup (already done in FastAPI on_event startup — good).
delivery.py: create_dispatch falls back from 'live' to 'simulated' silently on exception (mutates provider dict). Log the exception for observability once real Porter/Rapido keys are added.
payout.py: uses datetime.now() (local timezone) for the 'Generated' timestamp inside the PDF/CSV — use datetime.now(timezone.utc) for consistency with the rest of the app.

server.py:/api/orders/{id}/request-delivery only mutates deliveryPartner/dispatch/deliveryMode but does not update order.status — dispatched orders remain 'pending' unless explicitly accepted; consider auto-transitioning to 'accepted' or exposing status alongside dispatch state.
Frontend ImageUpload preview must have a stable data-testid like 'menu-image-upload-preview' on the element (currently reachable but not officially exposed) — helpful for tests.
